cases.title: Skip pattern src/*/api/** misses nested baselines and swallows tscompat suppressions
cases.diff_summary: Adds `src/*/api/**` to the CI skip-entirely patterns file so that generated API baselines never trigger CI.

expected_findings.summary: The pattern also matches src/Aspire.Hosting.<X>/api/*.tscompat.suppression.txt and src/Aspire.Hosting*/api/*.ats.txt, which the prefilter drops before both layers, so job:typescript-api-compat (and job:polyglot for *.ats.txt) never runs for a baseline change.
evidence_required: names job:typescript-api-compat (and/or job:polyglot) as the lost consumer
cites the path_rules entries for src/**/*.tscompat.suppression.txt or src/Aspire.Hosting*/api/*.ats.txt
states that prefilter drops matches before both layers

expected_findings.summary: `*` cannot cross '/', so the pattern does not match nested component baselines such as src/Components/Aspire.Foo/api/..., meaning the stated intent is only partially achieved.
evidence_required: cites the glob semantics from .github/actions/check-changed-files/action.yml or tools/SelectTests/ChangedFileFilter.cs
gives a concrete non-matching nested path

expected_non_findings: Do not ask for a new path_rules entry for generated src/*/api/*.cs files; they are not selector-routed and the concern is the skip pattern breadth.

cases.title: Removing the ATS baseline rule drops job:polyglot, and the replacement test only asserts NotEmpty
cases.diff_summary: Deletes the `src/Aspire.Hosting*/api/*.ats.txt -> [job:typescript-api-compat, job:polyglot]` path rule, relying on the generic tscompat suppression rule instead. Adds a test asserting that a baseline change selects a non-empty target set.

expected_findings.summary: An ordinary Aspire.Hosting.* exported-surface change now selects only job:typescript-api-compat; the polyglot playground that regenerates and compiles the exported surface per language no longer runs.
evidence_required: names job:polyglot as the dropped target
explains that the *.ats.txt baseline is not a compiled item, so Layer 1 cannot recover the route
gives a regression scenario, e.g. a PR editing src/Aspire.Hosting.Redis/api/Aspire.Hosting.Redis.ats.txt

expected_findings.summary: The replacement test asserts only that the selection is non-empty, so it stays green while job:polyglot coverage is lost; it must assert the exact expected target set or Assert.Contains("job:polyglot", ...).
evidence_required: names the added test method in tests/Infrastructure.Tests/TestTriggerMap/TestTriggerMapTests.cs
states the exact invariant the assertion should express

expected_non_findings: Do not request coverage in SelectTestsAcceptanceTests.cs; this is curated routing in the real map, which belongs in TestTriggerMapTests.cs.

cases.title: New source file and ProjectReference in an existing integration
cases.diff_summary: Adds a new extension method plus a ProjectReference in an integration that is already part of Aspire.slnx, and extends its existing test project.
expected_non_findings: Do not request an eng/github-ci/test-trigger-map.yml rule: these are ordinary MSBuild-evaluated inputs in the Aspire.slnx-rooted ProjectGraph, which Layer 1 owns.
Do not request a convention entry for tests/Aspire.Hosting.Redis.Tests; the existing convention plus Layer 1 already select it.

cases.title: New gated job added without complete run_* wiring and without a route for its reusable workflow
cases.diff_summary: Adds a selector-gated job in tests.yml that calls a new reusable workflow, adds a `job:new-validation` target to a path rule, but reuses an unrelated `run_*` output for the gate and adds no route for .github/workflows/new-validation.yml itself.

expected_findings.summary: The new job's `if:` consumes a run_* output that belongs to another target, so the job runs (or is skipped) independently of whether job:new-validation was selected.
evidence_required: names the job id and the run_* output it consumes in .github/workflows/tests.yml
states which selection boolean the job should consume
gives a regression scenario where selection and execution disagree

expected_findings.summary: A change to the implementing reusable workflow .github/workflows/new-validation.yml is not routed to job:new-validation, so editing the job's implementation does not run it.
evidence_required: names job:new-validation as the target it must route to

expected_non_findings: Do not request an `ALL` route for the new reusable workflow; the narrowest complete target set is the job it implements.

cases.title: Loose script routed to ALL when it has one concrete consumer
cases.diff_summary: Routes a single PowerShell script that only Infrastructure.Tests parses to `ALL`.

expected_findings.summary: The script has one identifiable consumer, so ALL runs the full matrix for every edit; the rule should target that consumer instead.
evidence_required: names the script path and the test project or job that consumes it

expected_non_findings: Do not claim coverage is lost; this is a cost finding, not a correctness finding, and must be reported as such.
